title: Dome of the Rock rhyme — God's house can't be rebuilt because of tumah (impurity)
summary: A humorous four-line rhyme (a parody of a nursery rhyme) saying that if the Dome of the Rock fell, nothing could put God's house together again, followed by the reason: tumah (טמאה), impurity.

text.text: The Dome of the Rock sits atop of the wall.
If the Dome of the Rock had a great fall
All the Jews’ horses and all the Jews’ men
Couldn’t put God’s house together again…

uncertain: tumah is in dark maroon; the Hebrew and the word Impurity share a slightly different brown, so only Impurity and the Hebrew are linked as the same colour.
